newsitem.title: USA: Cone sees Q2 in lower range of estimates.
newsitem.headline: Cone sees Q2 in lower range of estimates.

text.p: Cone Mills Corp said Friday that business conditions in the second half of 1997 may not improve as it had expected, and its second quarter results should be in the lower range of analysts' estimates.
Analysts estimates for the quarter are a loss of $0.03 per share, according to First Call.
The company reported earnings per share of $0.11 in the second quarter of 1996.
The company also said demand for its home furnishings fabrics has been less than expected, and it continues to experience poor operating results for its commission finishing division.
The company also said expected improvements in denim demand and its product mix have not yet developed for the third quarter, and operating schedules will be adjusted accordingly.
